request:
Use case: identity-preserve with pose transfer. Output ONE complete standalone 4:5 portrait illustration, not a reference sheet, side-by-side comparison or contact sheet.

IMAGE 1 is a human POSE AND FRAMING REFERENCE ONLY. Borrow its articulated stance: three-quarter torso, face toward viewer, right arm open palm toward viewer-left, left hand resting on hip, feet apart. It does NOT control identity, anatomy proportions, skin, face, hair, clothing, footwear or photographic rendering.
IMAGE 2 is the SOLE canonical Legacy MALE lion identity and illustrated-rendering authority. All of its views show one character. Replace the human completely with that exact lion, head and body together. Identity outranks the human silhouette: use the lion's athletic shoulder/arm/torso proportions and head/body scale while adapting the same joint pose.

Keep the lion's master-specific stern amber almond eyes and brows, broad but not enlarged pale feline muzzle and whisker pads, dark triangular nose, angular cheek structure, layered swept-back golden-brown mane tapering onto the chest, tawny arms, and one anatomically attached tufted golden tail. Preserve the fitted plain black short-sleeve shirt, black trousers and black sneakers from the lion master. Do not inherit the human's light-blue collared shirt, brown shoes, face, hair, jaw or narrower build. No generic lion substitution, rounded large eyes, mane inflation, muscle inflation, extra accessories or symbols.

Use the master’s clean semi-realistic illustrated mascot language: confident contour lines, soft cel shading, subtle form gradients, readable fur planes. The entire character must be illustrated consistently, not a lion head pasted onto a photographic human body. Both hands have clear natural anatomy; both shoes and tail are fully visible, no crop. Match the input portrait's simple light studio staging and general figure placement with a subtle ground shadow. Do not reproduce human features, add text, brand marks, extra characters, props or panels. Output only the finished canonical lion performing the supplied pose.
preserve: Human joint pose only; lion master controls all identity, proportions, wardrobe and illustration
scope_boundary: One principal character; bounded, explicitly requested changes.
